label: 参考混音分离版，不是正版母带，也不是 30 秒试听循环。
usable_as_temp_mix_bed: Yes, with holes and residual risk. Sit under new VO; raise only at the ending replay (~147s+), do not put music over the voice.

primary_file.path: /workspace/football-demo/bgm-reference-research/separated_exports/Rookie_空间阅读者_参考混音分离版_no_vocals.wav

float32_file: /workspace/football-demo/bgm-reference-research/separated_exports/Rookie_空间阅读者_参考混音分离版_no_vocals_float32.wav
vocals_inspect_file: /workspace/football-demo/bgm-reference-research/separated_exports/Rookie_空间阅读者_参考混音分离版_vocals.wav
method: Official demucs 4.1.0 htdemucs on CPU, segment 7. no_vocals = drums+bass+other.
why_not_mediakit: mediakit-cli install is free (npx @volcengine/mediakit-cli install -y), but audio separate-voice is Volcengine Cloud only and needs MEDIAKIT_API_KEY; the cloud API is billed. Key was unset. No purchase or login bypass.

algorithmic_checks.shazam_on_bed: Hits 人生志在一博 at 0,8,80,88,120s and passion at 147,158s; NO MATCH at 37s and 50s (energy hole).
algorithmic_checks.shazam_on_vocals_stem: NO MATCH at 0,8,120s but 人生志在一博 at 50s and passion at 158s — some music leaked into the vocals stem, so the bed is incomplete there.

problems: Energy holes around 35–45s (no_vocals ~-40 dB) and quiet/leaky 50–60s; a continuous 171s bed will drop out there.
Match/stadium SFX are not a Demucs class and remain in drums/other (53%/11% of bed energy). Not a clean music-only stem.
Silero VAD found no speech on the bed, but that is not a listening check and cannot certify zero commentary residual.
Loudness range is 13.7 LU vs the original mix 1.7 LU; the bed is not pre-levelled like the reference.
paid_master_blocker: Full official files were not obtained without purchase/login. Apple Music and NetEase pages remain the legal source; NetEase main track fee=8. Do not loop the 30s iTunes previews as a master.
